estimates: The original modern mapped building footprint and its four radial sectors establish the structure. The section is reconstructed from the documented 31-meter height, four ramped entrances, three roof-terrace rings, two glazed tiers and a saddle shell. The 1978 façade proportions, roof curvature and finishes are visual estimates.

The provider heightfield is preserved and includes probable influence from roofs or vegetation. It does not establish the 1978 forecourt survey grade. Foundations and ramps use approximate registration.
The model depicts the April 1978 exterior. Later station and renovated campus features, interiors and adjacent grounds are outside scope.

review.notes: Qualla was searched first. Its cleared April 1978 White House photo shows an indoor lectern and curtain. No exterior architecture is visible. The original mapped footprint, operator documents and written architectural field report supply the exterior controls. No source image was used.
